payload.name: Tavern Brawl
payload.description: You enter a tavern for a drink. A surly dwarf takes offense at your presence and throws a mug at your head!

success.description: You knock the dwarf flat. The tavern cheers! Free drinks for the rest of the night.

failure.description: The dwarf is surprisingly strong. You end up face-first on the floor.

success.description: You buy the dwarf a drink and end up hearing an interesting rumor about a nearby dungeon.

failure.description: Your words only make the dwarf angrier. You leave quickly.

choices.description: You dodge the mug and slip out. Not worth the trouble.

authority: Custom Crown campaign event, not an SRD trap/NPC/spell replacement
occurrence_policy: Table may roll again; same in-flight occurrence must not reroll/reapply on reopen. Campaign-specific uniqueness beyond generated room claims is unresolved, not silently global once-per-event-ID.
